component.name: Quixotic
component.summary: 异想天开的想法要在这里实现 — Desktop GUI for coding agents

description.p: Quixotic is an unofficial community fork derived from T3 Code (MIT License) for running local coding agents, reviewing code changes, and managing projects. It removes remote product telemetry and uses isolated local state directories.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by T3 Tools Inc.
